lines.text: In the great hall of Castle Brightstone, young Sir James stood before King Arthur himself.
Young Sir James, I have a most important quest for you.
I am ready, Your Majesty! What would you have me do?
You must journey to the Enchanted Forest and find the Crystal of Courage.
I won't let you down, Your Majesty!
And so began the greatest adventure Sir James had ever known.
